content.title: Micron earnings, Fed commentary: What to Watch
content.description:

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Domination Overtime.

content.title: Jobs Data, Inflation Report, Micron Earnings: Coming This Week
content.summary: The last full trading week before Christmas is looking busy. Key economic data that was delayed by the shutdown is due, including the jobs report and the consumer-price index for November. Some Federal Reserve policymakers are due to speak, after the central bank's latest rate cut last week, and a reasonably busy earnings calendar includes earnings from Nike, FedEx and Micron.
